load_npy_from_bytes: load a NumPy NDArray from bytes data using the efficient C++ implementation instead of numpy.load
load_npz_archive: load a numpy NPZ archive file from bytes and return an NpzFile object for dictionary-like access
access_npz_array_by_key: access an array from an NpzFile object by key with or without the .npy suffix
iterate_npz_files: iterate over the list of file names in an NpzFile object using its Mapping interface
check_npz_key_membership: check if a key exists in an NpzFile object using the contains method or in operator
